title: Page 10
content_zh:
「岳父大人真是够了。」原平之不接她的话，却抱怨起顾景宏：「哪有这样劝女儿的？一点都不知道维护自己的亲人，难怪当年岳母大人和他闹翻了！如果是我女婿对不起女儿，看我不狠狠揍他一顿！」

顾惜恩噗哧一声笑起来，说；「夫君最会护短了。」

「所以啊，你以后少给我再胡思乱想的，你是我的妻子，我不维护你还维护谁？」

「嗯。」顾惜恩重重地应了声，露出一个甜甜的笑脸。

这就是夫君和父亲的区别了，她的夫君将妻子当成「至亲」，始终呵护疼爱；而她的父亲却将妻子当成了「至疏」，哪怕他再爱她、喜欢她，也始终觉得还是自己的血缘亲人重要，所以当年母亲离开了他。

至亲至疏夫妻，就是这句话让顾惜恩忽然明白过来，她的夫君待她如至亲，她手里已经握着满满的幸福，她为什么还要自寻烦恼呢？

如果夫妻关系不好，就算有了孩子又怎样？世间多得是生了一堆儿却仍被丈夫嫌弃的女子。

选择夫君，看的是人品，而不是生子能力。

何其有幸，当年小小的她鼓足勇气选择了他？

金陵第一纨裤，在小小的顾惜恩眼中，却是第一漂亮、第一心软、第一心善的大哥哥，是值得托付终身的良人啊。

「夫君，我从很小很小就喜欢你了呢。」

「嗯嗯，睡觉了，困死了。」

顾惜恩翻了个身，背对着他，这家伙，真是越来越没情调。

原平之的双手不自觉地将她揽进怀里，继续睡。

顾惜恩偷偷地笑了一下，也跟着闭上双眼，陷入了沉睡。

玄昱登基二十年的时候，迁都燕京。

当时，皇帝玄昱年仅三十四岁。

由原平之主持建造的新京城巍峨雄浑，与南方的秀丽细腻不同，北方特有的厚重端方，更能展现皇权的至高无上。

历时十年的建设，让这个新的都城已经初具规模，紫禁城四面环绕着护城河，城墙四面各设一座城门，南午门，北玄武门，东华门，西华门，四角有壮丽的角楼。城内建筑沿着中轴线向东西两侧展开，规制悉如金陵，而壮丽过之。

紫禁城同样是前殿后宫，前面三大殿依然叫做奉天殿、华盖殿、谨身殿，两侧辅以文华、武英两殿，为前朝；后宫则以干清宫、交泰殿、坤宁宫以及东西六宫和御花园为中心，辅以其他一些殿阁。

前朝三大殿建筑在八尺高的三层汉白玉石阶上，当玄昱第一次在奉天殿上朝，他深深为这庄严宏伟的建筑而陶醉了，顾盼之间，豪气干云。

他回首对站在龙椅旁边的玄渊说：「看，这就是君临天下。」

番外　兄弟

原嘉铭坐在镇国将军府的外书房里，头疼地翻看着手里的账簿。

最近府里的支出骤增，账房特地找到了他，委婉地提醒他注意钱财流向，损失钱财事小，二少爷私自拿钱出去学坏了，可就事大了。

可是原嘉铭又不能死死卡住不放钱，毕竟私下拿钱出去的人是他的兄弟原嘉祯。

原嘉祯比原嘉铭小八岁，今年才十二岁，而且这个兄弟是父亲和母亲唯一的亲生子，是府里的超级小霸王，大家都宠着护着，养成了骄横的性子，原嘉铭也不敢轻易管教。

毕竟，原嘉铭清楚自己的身分，他是父母收养的义子，虽然当做嫡长子培养，可终究没有血脉牵绊，原嘉铭自从懂事以后，就再也没有放肆过。

血缘是个很奇妙的东西，它总是能让人很微妙地感觉到亲疏差别。

小的时候，原嘉铭以为自己是父母的亲生子，所以尽情撒娇耍赖，不想练武或念书的时候，也会跑到母亲身边装可怜求饶，那时候他很快活，很恣意，很舒心。

直到他八岁的时候，母亲怀孕了，生了个小弟弟，而他的姑姑冯敏婷这才突然说出了他的真正身世——原来他不是父母的亲生子，他的亲生父亲是为了救养父而牺牲的。

姑姑教导他要努力上进，要小心讨好父母，要宠爱呵护弟弟，再不能撒娇放肆。

姑姑说：「你要懂事。」

对于孩子来说，懂事真是件让人痛苦的事。

从那以后，原嘉铭心底就隐隐有了芥蒂，有了份莫名的悲伤，他觉得无论自己如何做，也不会如弟弟那么讨人喜欢。

现在原嘉铭已经二十岁了，去年就已经娶亲，今年也有了自己的嫡长子，他却在考虑，是不是应该放弃自己「嫡长子」的身分了？

晚上，原嘉铭趁着父亲绘画的时候，在画室找到他。

父亲在家的时候，大半时间都陪伴着母亲，只有在他潜心作画的时候，才会喜欢单独一个人。

父亲和母亲的感情很好，这让原嘉铭很羡慕，也立志以他们为榜样，要善待自己的嫡妻。

原平之听了原嘉铭的话之后，缓缓放下了画笔。

过了不惑之年的他依然俊美，如芝兰玉树，却又增添了中年人特有的成熟雍容，反而让他越发富有魅力。

燕京的工程主体建造已经完毕，后期建设原平之也早已移交给了别人，现在的他重新恢复了优闲，甚至连家务事也交给了长子负责，又恢复了富贵闲人的气派。

原嘉铭看着父亲渐渐收敛起脸上的笑意，忍不住心慌起来，他知道父亲是个心软和善的人，可这并不代表他没有脾气。相反的，他的贵公子脾气也是大得很呢。

「你说，你想辞去镇国将军府嫡长子的名头？」原平之语气平淡地问。

原嘉铭犹豫了一会儿，才点头，然后急忙补充道：「我依然是父母的儿子，依然会孝顺你们的，只是我觉得自己没有必要占着嫡长子的名义，还是归还给弟弟才好，也算实至名归。」

「没有必要？什么叫必要？长大了翅膀硬了，不需要父母的保护了，所以想脱离将军府？」

「不是！」原嘉铭摇头，急忙说：「不是！」

他明明只是不想占弟弟的便宜，想让父母的亲生儿子继承他们的家业的！

「那你到底是什么？」原平之勃然变色，在原嘉铭还没反应过来之前，一记巴掌已经狠狠甩在了他的脸庞上。

火辣辣的痛。

更让原嘉铭难堪的，是他长这么大还从来没被父亲和母亲打过，这是第一次。

「知道我为什么打你吗？」原平之冷笑道：「我打你忘恩负义，我打你自私自利，我打你不孝顺父母，我打你不友爱手足！」

原嘉铭低垂着头，心里却万般委屈。

「觉得委屈了？爹娘把你养大，就是为了让你觉得自己是个被收养的义子？不管当初我为什么收养你，我和你娘都把你当做亲生儿子养大，你听了别人三言两语的挑拨，就与我们疏远了？你这不叫不孝，还能叫什么？」

原嘉铭羞耻得满脸通红，越发地低下了头。

「你的生父是个至情至性的大男人，身为你的养父，我自认也是重情重义的性情中人，怎么你就不学学我们，偏偏学闺阁女子的那一套斤斤计较？你丢不丢人？大男人为人处世，自当有自己的堂堂准则，行得正坐得端，他人言语只能当做借鉴，不能把自己变成随风倒的墙头草！」

「爹……」

「你少叫我！最近我就看你不顺眼了，优柔寡断的模样，看了就讨厌。你让出嫡长子的位置，是要彰显自己的大度吗？那你将父母置于何地？让父母变成世人眼中忘恩负义、偏宠亲生子的恶人吗？你又将你弟弟置于何地？让他也变成好逸恶劳、手足反目的恶人吗？」
content_en:
"Father-in-law, that's enough." Yuan Pingzhi didn't accept her words, but complained to Gu Jinghong: "How could you persuade your daughter like this? You don't know how to protect your own relatives. No wonder my mother-in-law had a falling out with him back then! If it's my son-in-law who can't forgive my daughter, I won't give him a good beating!"

Gu Xien burst into laughter and said, "Husbands are the best at protecting shortcomings."

"So, don't let me think too much in the future. You are my wife. If I don't protect you, who will I protect?"

"Yes." Gu Xien responded solemnly, showing a sweet smile.

This is the difference between a husband and a father. Her husband regards his wife as a "closest relative" and always cares and loves her; but her father regards his wife as a "closest". No matter how much he loves and likes her, he always feels that he is still his blood relative and that is why her mother left him that year.

It was these words that made Gu Xien suddenly understand that her husband treated her like a close relative, and she already held a lot of happiness in her hands, so why should she look for trouble?

If the relationship between husband and wife is not good, what if they have children?There are many women in the world who have given birth to a lot of children but are still rejected by their husbands.

Choosing a husband depends on his character, not his ability to have children.

How lucky she was that she mustered up the courage to choose him when she was young?

The most handsome man in Jinling, in the eyes of little Gu Xien, is the most beautiful, soft-hearted, and kind-hearted elder brother. He is a beloved man worthy of being entrusted to him for life.

"Husband, I have liked you since I was very young."

"Yeah, let's go to bed. I'm so sleepy."

Gu Xien turned over and turned her back to him. This guy was really becoming more and more unemotional.

Yuan Pingzhi's hands unconsciously pulled her into his arms and continued to sleep.

Gu Xien smiled secretly, closed her eyes and fell into a deep sleep.

Twenty years after Xuan Yu ascended the throne, he moved the capital to Yanjing.

At that time, Emperor Xuan Yu was only thirty-four years old.

The new capital city built under the leadership of Yuan Pingzhi is majestic and majestic. Different from the beauty and delicacy in the south, the unique heavy and regular structure in the north can better demonstrate the supremacy of imperial power.

After ten years of construction, this new capital city has begun to take shape. The Forbidden City is surrounded by a moat. There is a gate on each side of the city wall, the South Meridian Gate, the North Xuanwu Gate, the Donghua Gate, and the Xihua Gate. There are magnificent turrets at the four corners.The buildings in the city spread out along the central axis to the east and west sides. The regulations are as detailed as the Jinling, but even more magnificent.

The Forbidden City also has a front palace and a back palace. The three front halls are still called Fengtian Hall, Huagai Hall, and Jinshen Hall, supplemented by Wenhua Hall and Wuying Hall on both sides, which are the front dynasty; the back palace is centered on Qianqing Palace, Jiaotai Hall, Kunning Palace, the Sixth East and West Palaces and the Imperial Garden, supplemented by some other palaces.

The three main halls of the previous dynasty were built on eight-foot-high three-story white marble steps. When Xuanyu went to court in Fengtian Hall for the first time, he was deeply intoxicated by this solemn and magnificent building, and he was full of pride as he looked at it.

He turned back to Xuan Yuan who was standing next to the dragon chair and said, "Look, this is King Lin Tianxia."

Extra: Brothers

Yuan Jiaming was sitting in the outer study of the Zhenguo General's Mansion, looking through the account books in his hand with a headache.

The expenditure in the house has increased sharply recently, and the accountant specially found him and gently reminded him to pay attention to the flow of money. Losing money is a small matter, but the second young master took the money out privately to learn bad things, but it will be a big deal.

But Yuan Jiaming couldn't hold on and not release the money. After all, the person who took the money privately was his brother Yuan Jiazhen.

Yuan Jiazhen is eight years younger than Yuan Jiaming, and is only twelve years old this year. Moreover, this brother is the only biological son of his father and mother. He is the super bully in the house. Everyone loves and protects him, and he has developed an arrogant temper. Yuan Jiaming does not dare to discipline him easily.

After all, Yuan Jiaming knew his identity well. He was the adopted son of his parents. Although he was raised as the eldest son, he was not tied by blood after all. Yuan Jiaming had never been presumptuous since he became sensible.

Blood relationship is a very wonderful thing, it can always make people feel the difference between closeness and distance very subtly.

When he was young, Yuan Jiaming thought he was his parents' biological son, so he acted like a spoiled brat to his heart's content. When he didn't want to practice martial arts or study, he would run to his mother and pretend to be pitiful and beg for mercy. At that time, he was very happy, carefree, and comfortable.

It wasn't until he was eight years old that his mother became pregnant and gave birth to a little brother, and his aunt Feng Minting suddenly revealed his true life experience - it turned out that he was not his parents' biological son, and his biological father died to save his adoptive father.

His aunt taught him that he should work hard to make progress, be careful to please his parents, pamper and protect his younger brother, and never act like a spoiled brat.

My aunt said, "You have to be sensible."

For children, being sensible is really painful.

From then on, Yuan Jiaming had a vague grudge in his heart and felt an inexplicable sadness. He felt that no matter what he did, he would never be as lovable as his brother.

Yuan Jiaming is now twenty years old. He got married last year and has his eldest son this year. But he is thinking about whether he should give up his status as the "eldest son"?

In the evening, Yuan Jiaming found his father in the studio while he was painting.

When my father is at home, he spends most of his time with his mother. He only likes to be alone when he is concentrating on painting.

The relationship between his father and mother was very good, which made Yuan Jiaming envious, and he also determined to follow their example and treat his legitimate wife well.

After listening to Yuan Jiaming's words, Yuan Pingzhi slowly put down his painting brush.

After forty years, he is still handsome, like a orchid or a jade tree, but he has added the maturity and grace unique to middle-aged people, which makes him even more charming.

The main construction of the Yanjing project has been completed, and the later construction of Yuan Pingzhi has long been handed over to others. Now he has regained his leisure, and even handed over the housework to his eldest son, and has restored the style of a wealthy and idle man.

Yuan Jiaming watched his father gradually lose the smile on his face, and couldn't help but feel flustered. He knew that his father was a soft-hearted and kind person, but this did not mean that he had no temper.On the contrary, his noble temper is also very big.

"You said, you want to resign as the eldest son of the Zhenguo General's Mansion?" Yuan Pingzhi asked in a calm tone.

Yuan Jiaming hesitated for a while, then nodded, and then hurriedly added: "I am still the son of my parents, and I will still be filial to you, but I don't think I need to occupy the name of the eldest son. It is better to return it to my younger brother, which is well deserved."

"Isn't it necessary? What do you mean by necessity? When you grow up and your wings harden, you don't need your parents' protection anymore, so you want to leave the General's Mansion?"

"No!" Yuan Jiaming shook his head and said hurriedly: "No!"

He obviously just didn't want to take advantage of his younger brother and wanted his parents' biological son to inherit their family business!

"Then what are you?" Yuan Pingzhi suddenly changed color, and before Yuan Jiaming could react, he slapped him hard on the face.

Burning pain.

What makes Yuan Jiaming even more embarrassed is that this is the first time that he has never been beaten by his father and mother in his whole life.

"Do you know why I beat you?" Yuan Pingzhi sneered: "I beat you for being ungrateful, I beat you for being selfish, I beat you for not being filial to your parents, I beat you for not being friendly to your siblings!"

Yuan Jiaming lowered his head, feeling extremely aggrieved.

"Feel wronged? Did your parents raise you just to make you feel like an adopted son? No matter why I adopted you in the first place, your mother and I raised you as our biological son. You just listened to others' instigation and distanced yourself from us? If you don't call this unfilial, what else can you call it?"

Yuan Jiaming's face turned red with shame and he lowered his head even more.

"Your biological father is a very affectionate man. As your adoptive father, I consider myself to be a man of love and justice. Why don't you imitate us, but instead imitate the caress of women in the boudoir? Are you embarrassed? A grown man should have his own dignified rules when it comes to dealing with others, and he should behave upright. The words of others can only be used as a reference, and you cannot turn yourself into a weed in the wind!"

"Dad..."

"Don't call me that! I've been annoyed by your indecisiveness recently. Do you want to show your generosity by giving up the position of your eldest son? Then where do you put your parents? Do you turn your parents into evil people who are ungrateful and favor their own children in the eyes of the world? Where do you put your younger brother? Do you let him become an evil person who is indolent and fraternal?"
